definitions.explanation: Financial aid given to students to help pay for their education. In Japan, many scholarships are actually interest-free or low-interest loans that must be repaid after graduation.

examples.japanese: {奨学金|しょうがくきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申|もう}し{込|こ}んだ→申し込む：02311_moushikomu⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{奨学金|しょうがくきん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: She attends university on a scholarship.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧⟦{後|ご}→後：noentry⟧、{奨学金|しょうがくきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{返済|へんさい}→返済：04776_hensai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: After graduation, repayment of the student loan began.
examples.notes: Many Japanese {奨学金|しょうがくきん} are technically loans (⟦{貸与|たいよ}→貸与：15912_taiyo⟧⟦{型|がた}→型：noentry⟧) rather than grants (⟦{給付|きゅうふ}→給付：13848_kyuufu⟧⟦{型|がた}→型：noentry⟧)

notes:
{奨学金|しょうがくきん} in Japan often functions differently from Western scholarships.

TYPES:
- ⟦{給付|きゅうふ}→給付：13848_kyuufu⟧⟦{型|がた}→型：noentry⟧{奨学金|しょうがくきん} (grant-type scholarship - no repayment)
- ⟦{貸与|たいよ}→貸与：15912_taiyo⟧⟦{型|がた}→型：noentry⟧{奨学金|しょうがくきん} (loan-type scholarship - must be repaid)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {奨学金|しょうがくきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to receive a scholarship)
- {奨学金|しょうがくきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{返|かえ}す→返す：09648_kaesu⟧ (to repay a student loan)
- {奨学金|しょうがくきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧ (to get a scholarship)

CULTURAL NOTE:
The Japan Student Services Organization (JASSO) is the main provider of student loans in Japan.
